about: The similarity model, pinned: the Hugging Face repo, its commit and each file's SHA-256. `python -m engine fetch-model` downloads these into ENGINE_MODEL_DIR (outside the repo) and refuses a mismatch; model files are never committed. The commit and hashes are filled in Part B1, when the session can reach huggingface.co. pooling: the repo's 1_Pooling/config.json (CLS). Changing anything here changes the model version recorded with every vector.
